releaseNotes: Workbook Audit is now actionable — every finding shows what Elmashad can do: Safe Fix, Review Fix, Guided Action, Manual Review or Information.
Exact cell detection for numbers stored as text — findings point at the precise cell (with the analyzed region shown separately), never a broad column range.

Convert to Number — a previewed, dependency-checked fix for text numbers in numeric columns, with identifier and precision protections (leading zeros, 16+ digit IDs and mixed codes are never converted) and full undo.
Unhide Sheet guided actions for hidden worksheets (including VeryHidden, with a stronger warning) — one sheet or several at once, always confirmed; undo restores the original hidden states.
Review Fixes is now Review Actions — safe fixes, review-and-confirm actions, guided actions and manual-review items in one pane; it stays enabled even when only guided actions exist.
New Fix Safe button — one click applies only the safe fixes through the single backup → confirm → apply → verify → undo transaction.
Ignore Finding — accepted findings are remembered per workbook and reopen automatically when the cell content changes.
Go to Cell works for range findings and opens hidden sheets after an explicit unhide prompt.
Exported report now shows exact affected cells, the analyzed region, available actions and the full action history.
